label: Level
description: The character's experience level, from 1 to 10. Level lowers saving throws and sets the class hit die, attack bonus, skill points, focus picks, and castings gained on advancement.

label: Experience
description: Cumulative experience points. XP never resets; reaching the next level's threshold allows the character to advance after a day or two of downtime.

label: Skill Points
description: Unspent skill points. One point raises one skill by a level, to a maximum of level 4. Experts and partial Experts gain an extra point each level.

label: Focus Picks
description: Unspent focus picks granted by the character's class at certain levels. A pick learns one focus; a rank-2 focus needs its rank-1 version first.
